name: Shigusa Miya
source:
The eldest daughter of the Shigusa family. 

She’s a kind, sociable woman. 

She married [url=/c11250]Kensei[/url] out of love and they have a close relationship. 

"[url=/c101556]Satsuki[/url]-san, [url=/c11249]Saya’s[/url] waiting for you."
